name: VM right-sizing report
summary: Advisory vCPU / memory recommendations from vCenter performance history.
description: Reads CPU and memory usage history from vCenter (average and 95th percentile) for one VM or every powered-on VM of a cluster (max 200) and flags oversized (WARN) and undersized (FAIL) VMs with a recommended size. Nothing is changed; apply a recommendation with the 'Resize VM' item.

inputs.name: VMName
inputs.label: Virtual machine (optional)
inputs.help: Leave empty to analyse every powered-on VM of the cluster (max 200).

inputs.name: LookbackDays
inputs.label: Look back (days)
inputs.help: Up to 30 days uses 2-hour samples; longer periods use daily samples.
